content.short: Tweed provides a wallet API for creating self-custody wallets.
content.description: Tweed SDK enables any Web2 platform to offer a fully functional Web3 experience, bridging traditional apps with blockchain capabilities without compromising usability. It emphasizes a smooth user experience while preserving platform independence and strong protection for user funds. The embedded wallet provides true self-custody: only the user can sign transactions, no other party can sign on the user's behalf, and funds stay secure even in the event of a data breach.
